description: This file is a BitBake recipe (.inc file) defining the build and installation process for the Quagga routing software suite. It includes metadata such as description, homepage, dependencies, build configuration options, service files, package splitting, and install steps.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Defines the installation steps for the Quagga package, including copying init scripts, configuration samples, setting permissions, and installing systemd service files. Also includes path corrections and conditional behaviors based on distro features.

methods.name: pkg_postinst
methods.description: Post-installation function to mask the quagga service with systemd after package installation, if applicable.

methods.name: pkg_prerm
methods.description: Pre-removal functions to stop specific Quagga daemons via init.d scripts before removal.
